Elon Musk faces lawsuits and AI dilemmas

Elon Musk's companies are facing multiple lawsuits. One lawsuit alleges that his AI chatbot Grok profited from child abuse images and explicit content, with the company stating it acted to tighten protections against misuse of its image and video generation tool. Attorneys General also argue that sexual images from Musk's AI chatbot harmed consumers. Separately, Musk's SpaceX is renting computing power from its data centers to competitors like Anthropic, which is reportedly making it harder for his own AI efforts. Musk has also suggested that former baristas and shelf-stockers would be suitable for SpaceX data center roles.
